messages:
rachel (AE): Heads-up: BlueWave signed the MSA and wants a 30-day POC. Need: billing org + project, dedicated pool (temp), VPC peering, ephemeral API keys for devs, hard spend cap $5,000, and logs forwarded to their S3 bucket. Who can own?

diego (SE): Nice. What model family + expected peak load? pool sizing depends on seq length and concurrency.

rachel (AE): They want to test with rlhf-tuned-medium, ~6k seq, expected burst ~40 rps, steady ~6 rps. Also asked whether dedicated commit can be prorated for a single month.

tara (Platform Eng): For that profile I'd suggest a 3x A100 pool with burst policy. We can do a prorated short-term commit for one month but reserved pricing applies; will confirm exact $ in DM. We support ephemeral API keys via service accounts; keys can be minted with 2hr TTL.

mike (Finance): We can attach $10,000 trial credits to the billing project and set platform-enforced hard cap at $5,000. If they hit the cap, requests will be blocked unless sales/finance approved a temporary lift + signed amendment.

nora (CS): I'll collect their VPC CIDR and infra contact. Also clarifying: they want logs exported and encrypted with their KMS key. Is that supported?

tara (Platform Eng): Yes: cross-account S3 export + customer-managed KMS supported. We'll need their IAM role ARN for the S3 write role. I will open INFRA ticket for peering and log-export.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4650 for "bluewave poc: billing project, dedicated pool, vpc peering, s3 log export" assigned to @tara. https://redwood.internal/INFRA-4650

tara (Platform Eng): Action items from platform: (1) project id to create, (2) customer S3 bucket + role ARN, (3) CIDR + peering contact, (4) desired start/end dates for any extra burst capacity.

diego (SE): Example spend/quotas we recommend to attach to the billing project: 
```yaml
billing_project: bluewave-poc-2000
hard_cap_usd: 5000
trial_credits_usd: 10000
quotas:
  max_requests_per_min: 400
  max_tokens_per_day: 1500000
ephemeral_keys_ttl_minutes: 120
```

mike (Finance): Can confirm trial credits reserved. Please provide final project id and I'll attach credits and set the hard cap. Also noting: dedicated pool minimum monthly commit applies; we'll provide the numeric quote in the ticket.

rachel (AE): I'll collect the bucket/role and CIDR today and post. Target: POC ready in 4 business days.

tara (Platform Eng): I'll start IAM role and pool reservation tomorrow and post updates on INFRA-4650.

nora (CS): Will coordinate SOC2 checklist items with the customer; they requested 12-month log retention and alerting on admin changes.

diego (SE): Once infra PRs are up I'll validate the pool config with a short perf run.

rachel (AE): Thanks everyone. Summary: nora collects networking and SOC answers, tara provisions infra and ephemeral key flow, mike attaches credits and enforces cap, diego validates pool performance. Goal: POC launch in 4d. :thumbsup:
